title: LORD, I COMMIT THE MONTH OF JANUARY INTO YOUR HANDS
text: Beloved, before we go into the deep waters of prayer and prophecy this hour, I want you to do something very significant. I want you to share this ministration with somebody. There is a grace that follows shared content. When you share what blesses you, you activate the principle of multiplication. The Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself." Share this with your family members, with your colleagues, with those in your prayer groups. There are people who need this prophetic word for January. There are destinies connected to yours that must hear what the spirit is saying. Don't just be a receiver. Become a distributor of grace. Share it now. And as you do, you are activating angelic assistance over your own life. The same grace that will touch them will double back to you in Jesus's mighty name. Now lift up your voice wherever you are and begin to bless the Lord. Magnify his name. Worship him with understanding. The Bible says [music] in Psalm 100, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his court with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." January is not just another month on the calendar. It is a prophetic doorway. It is the entrance into a new season. And what you commit to God in prayer, what you establish in the spirit realm will determine how the rest of your year unfolds. This is not religious routine. This is strategic spiritual warfare. This is covenant engagement with the Almighty. I see you right now in the realm of the spirit. I see grace upon your life. I see divine enablement. I see the oil of God's anointing settling upon your circumstances. But you must open your mouth and decree. You must pray with intentionality. Heaven is not moved by your need. Heaven is moved by your faith expressed through prayer. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availth much. Not the casual prayer, not the religious prayer, but the prayer that is loaded with faith, saturated with the word and activated by the Holy Ghost. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before your throne of grace on behalf of every soul that is connected to this [music] moment. Lord, I ask that you would open their spiritual eyes. Let them see beyond the physical. Let them perceive the dimensions of the spirit where battles are won and destinies are established. I pray that every form of spiritual dullness, every form of prayerlessness, every spirit of slumber that has kept them from taking their place in prayer, I command it to be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Let there be a staring in their spirit right now. Let there be a hunger for the supernatural. Let there be a desperation for your presence. We reject complacency. We reject mediocrity. we step into the fullness of what you have prepared for us in this season. Now listen to me very carefully. The month of January carries prophetic significance in the Hebrew calendar. Understanding times and seasons is not optional. It is strategic. The Bible says the sons of Issacha were men who had understanding of the times and knew what Israel ought to do. You are a son or daughter of Issacha [music] in this generation. You must understand that January is not just a beginning. It is a foundation. What you build in January, what you establish in January, what you decree in January will [music] set the spiritual atmosphere for the remaining 11 months. This is why the enemy fights people's prayer life in January. This is why there is so much distraction, so much warfare, so much confusion at the beginning of the year. The devil knows that if he can steal your January, he has stolen your year. But I have come as a prophet [music] to tell you that your January is secured in God. Every plan of darkness against this month is cancelled by the blood of Jesus. Every agenda of the enemy to waste your time to scatter your focus to drain your spiritual fire is destroyed right now in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy over you this January will be [music] the best January of your life. You will not struggle like you struggled in previous Januaries. You will not experience the delays, the setbacks, the frustrations that have characterized previous beginnings. This is your season of ease. This is your season of divine acceleration. Things that took others 12 months to accomplish, you will accomplish in one month because the spirit of the Lord is upon you. Father, I commit the month of January into your hands. I recognize that except the Lord builds the house, they labor in vain that build it. Except the Lord keeps the city, the watchman, wicked but in vain. We are not trusting in our strength. We're not leaning on our understanding. We're not depending on human connections or material resources. Our trust is in you. The God who cannot fail. The God who does not lie. The God whose word never returns void. I commit every [music] day of this month into your hands. I commit every plan, every project, every vision, every dream into your hands. Let your divine orchestration be upon our lives. Let your supernatural guidance lead us into the paths [music] of righteousness. Let your wisdom illuminate our decisions. Let your favor open doors that no man can shut. I want you to understand something about commitment. When you commit something to God, you are not just saying a prayer. You are entering into a covenant transaction. The word commit in Hebrew is galal which means to roll over to transfer the weight. You are rolling over the burden of this month from your shoulders to his shoulders. You are transferring the weight of responsibility [music] from your limited capacity to his unlimited ability. The Bible says in Proverbs 16:3, "Commit thy works unto the Lord and thy thoughts shall be established." When you commit, God establishes. When you release, God takes over. When you surrender, God steps in with his supernatural intervention. Now, there are people watching this right now who have been carrying burdens that do not belong to them. You have been struggling with issues that should have been handed over to God a long time ago. You have been carrying the weight of your business, the weight of your marriage, the weight of your children, the weight of your health on your own shoulders, and it has been breaking you. The Lord is saying to you today, "Cast your burden upon me and I will sustain you. I will never permit the righteous to be moved." This is your moment of release. This is your moment of transfer. This is your moment to let go and let God. Father, I pray for every believer who is carrying weights that they were never designed to carry. I pray for those who have been struggling with anxiety, fear, worry, and depression because they have not learned the art of committing their ways to you. Lord, teach them how to trust you. Teach them how to release. Teach them how to rest in your finished work. I decree that every heavy burden is lifted right now in the name of Jesus. Every yoke of anxiety is broken. Every chain of fear is shattered. Every limitation that has been imposed by worry and overthinking is destroyed by the power of the Holy Ghost. I release peace into their minds. I release rest into their souls. I release confidence into their spirits. They will walk in the assurance that you are working all things together for [music] their good. January is a month of fresh beginnings, but not every beginning is productive. There are people who start the year with great excitement, with great resolutions, with great plans, but by February everything has collapsed. Why? Because they started in their own strength. They started without divine alignment. They started without consecration. They started without prayer. But you are different. You are starting this month with God. You are starting with prayer. You are starting with consecration. You are starting with the word. And because you are starting right, you will finish right. I prophesy to you, you will finish what you start this month, you will not be like those who begin projects and abandon them. You will not be like those who start well but end badly. The grace of completion is upon you. The spirit of diligence is upon you. The anointing for sustained momentum is upon you. Every project you begin in this month, God will [music] give you the grace to complete. Every vision you conceive, God will give you the wisdom to execute. Every dream you carry, God will give you the resources to manifest. This is your season of completion. This is your season of manifestation. This is your season of actualization. Father, I pray for supernatural enablement. I pray for divine ability. I pray that you would release grace upon grace into the lives of your people. Let them not struggle. Let them not labor in futility. Let them not experience the frustration of wasted effort. I decree that every work of their hands is blessed. Every legitimate endeavor is prospered. Every righteous pursuit is crowned with success. They will not walk in vain. They will not labor for nothing. They will not sow [music] without reaping. The blessing of the Lord upon their lives makes them rich and adds no sorrow. Everything they touch in this month [music] prospers. Everything they handle flourishes. Everything they engage with multiplies. This is their season of supernatural increase. Now I want to talk to you about spiritual warfare. January is a month of intense spiritual activity. The kingdom of darkness is always aggressive at the beginning of the year because they know that if they can establish a stronghold in your mind, in your emotions, in your circumstances at the beginning of the year, they can torment you all year long. But I have come to tell you that you are not a victim. You are a warrior. You are not defenseless. You are armed with the whole armor of God. You are not helpless. You are empowered by the Holy Ghost. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, [music] but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Your battle is not with people. Your battle is not with circumstances. Your battle is with invisible forces that manipulate circumstances and influence people. And you cannot fight a spiritual battle with physical weapons. You need spiritual weapons. You need prayer. You need fasting. You need the word of God. You need the blood of Jesus. You need the name of Jesus. You need [music] the fire of the Holy Ghost. I release the fire of God upon your life right now. Every demon that has been assigned against your January, [music] I command them to be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. every witchcraft operation, every evil monitoring, every satanic surveillance, every demonic agenda against your life and destiny, I decree total destruction by the fire of the Holy Ghost. You are not a candidate for spiritual attack. You are not a victim of evil manipulation. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. You are hidden in Christ. You are seated in heavenly places far above all principality and power. No weapon fashioned against you shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord. Father, I take authority over every spirit of delay that is targeting the breakthroughs of your people in this month. I take authority over every spirit of stagnation that wants to keep them in the same position where they were last year. I take authority over every spirit of failure that wants to sabotage their efforts and frustrate their pursuits. I command these spirits to be bound and cast out in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree acceleration. I decree advancement. I decree elevation. I decree promotion. Things that should have taken years will happen in weeks. Things that should have taken months will happen in days. This is their season of supernatural speed. This is their season of divine acceleration. They will not be delayed. They will not be denied. They will not be disadvantaged. Heaven is backing them. Angels are working for them. God himself is fighting for them. I want you to open your mouth right now and begin to make prophetic declarations. The Bible says life and death are in the power of the tongue. You have the ability to create your reality with your words. Stop complaining. Stop murmmoring. Stop speaking negatively. Begin to decree what you desire. Begin to declare what you believe. Begin to prophesy what you see in the spirit. Call those things that be not as though they were. Speak to your genuary. Speak to your finances. Speak to your health. Speak to your career. Speak to your family. Speak to your ministry. Whatever you desire that is in alignment with God's will, open your mouth and decree it. Say this with me. January, I decree that you will be the best month of my life. I decree that you will be a month of open doors. I decree that you will be a month of divine connections. I decree that you will be a month of supernatural provision. I decree that you will be a month of answered prayers. I decree that you will be a month of fulfilled prophecies. I decree that you will be a month of manifestation. I decree that everything I touch in you will prosper. Every seed I sow in you will multiply. Every prayer I pray in you will be answered. Every step I take in you will be ordered by the Lord. I will not stumble. I will not fall. I will not fail. I will not be defeated. I am more than a conqueror through Christ Jesus who loves me. Father, I thank you because your word says that the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord and he delights in his way. I pray that you would order the steps of your people in this month. Let every step they take be a step into blessing. Let every move they make be a move into favor. Let every decision they take be a decision that leads to progress. I pray against wrong turns, against wrong connections, against wrong investments, against wrong relationships. Give them discernment. Give them wisdom. Give them the spirit of counsel. Let them walk in divine alignment. Let them move in sync with your perfect will. Where they need to go, open the way. Where they need to stop, close the door. Where they need to wait, give them patience. Where they need to move, give them boldness. Lead them by your spirit into the fullness of their destiny. Now, I want to address something very critical. There are people who have been experiencing warfare in their finances. January is often a difficult month financially for many people because of expenses from December, because of school fees, because of house rent, because of many obligations. But I prophesy to you, your January will not be like the January of others. While others are crying, you will be celebrating. While others are borrowing, you will be lending. While others are struggling, you will be flourishing. God is about to release supernatural provision into your life. unexpected income, unusual favor, divine connections that will open doors of financial blessing. The Bible says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Not according to the economy, not according to your salary, not according to your business, according to his riches in glory. His resources are unlimited. His supply is inexhaustible. His provision is supernatural. You are not depending on your job for supply. You are depending on Jehovah Gyra, the God who provides. And he has never failed anyone who trusted him. Father, I decrease supernatural financial provision for your people in this month. Let money locate them from sources they never expected. Let opportunities for increase come to them from directions they never anticipated. I decree divine debt cancellation. Every legitimate debt, let there be supernatural provision for payment. I decree increase in their business, increase in their income, increase in their investments, let their expectations not be cut off. Let their hope not be disappointed. You said in your word that those who trust in you shall not lack any good thing. I hold you to your word. I remind you of your promise. Let it be fulfilled in their lives this morning. Open the windows of heaven and pour out blessings that they will not have room enough to receive. Let their bands be filled with plenty. Let their vs overflow with new wine. This is their season of overflow. This is their season of abundance. This is their season of more than enough. I want you to lift up your hands right now and begin to thank God. Begin to worship him. Begin to magnify his name. Gratitude is a spiritual weapon. Thanksgiving is a form of warfare. When you thank God in advance for what he's about to do, you are demonstrating faith. When you worship him before you see the manifestation, you are activating the supernatural. The Bible says in 2 Chronicles 20, when Jehoshaphat and the children of Israel were surrounded by their enemies, God told them, "You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord." And when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushments against their enemies and they destroyed themselves. Your worship is a weapon. Your praise is a strategy. Your thanksgiving is a key that unlocks divine intervention. Father, I thank you for what you are about to do in this month. I thank you for the miracles that are coming. I thank you for the testimonies that are loading. I thank you for the breakthroughs that are on the way. I thank you because you are faithful. I thank you because you are reliable. I thank you because you never fail. We worship you not because of what [music] you do but because of who you are. You are the alpha and the omega. You are the beginning and the end. You are the king of kings and the lord of lords. You are the god who was and is and is to come. You are the god who sits upon the throne and reigns forever. [music] We exalt you. We magnify you. We glorify your name. Let your kingdom come. Let your will be done in our lives as it is in heaven. Now, I want to pray specifically for those who are believing God for marital breakthrough. January is your month. I decree that divine connections are coming your way. I decree that the right person will locate you. I decree that every wrong relationship will be exposed and disconnected. I decree that you will not marry the wrong person. You will not settle for less than God's best. The Lord will lead you to your spouse by [music] his spirit. There will be peace. There will be confirmation. There will be clarity. You will not be confused. You will not be manipulated. You will not be deceived. The Lord himself will present your spouse to you and you will know beyond every shadow of doubt that this is the will of God for your life. Father, I pray for singles who are trusting you for life partners. I pray that you would prepare them even as you are preparing their spouse. Let them not be in a hurry. Let them not be desperate. Let them not compromise their standards because of societal pressure. Give them the grace to wait for your perfect timing. And when the time is right, bring them together in a way that will glorify your name. I decree that their marriages will be strong. Their homes will be filled with peace. Their relationships will be a testimony of your goodness. No divorce, no separation, no regrets. They will marry right and they will stay married by the power of the Holy Ghost. For those who are already married, I pray for restoration. I pray for renewal. I pray for revival. Every marriage that is experiencing crisis, I decree divine intervention. Every home that is under attack, I decree supernatural protection. Let there be love. Let there be understanding. Let there be forgiveness. Let there be communication. Let the presence of God saturate that home. Let the peace of God rule in that marriage. Let the joy of the Lord be the strength of that family. No weapon fashioned against that marriage shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against that union in judgment, they shall condemn. That home will stand. That marriage will flourish. That family will be a light in their generation. I also want to pray for those who are believing God for the fruit of the womb. This is your month of conception. This is your season of fruitfulness. The same God who opened the womb of Sarah, the same God who opened the womb of Hannah, the same God who opened the womb of Elizabeth is opening your womb right now. Every medical report that says you cannot conceive is canled by the word of God. Every pronouncement of barness is reversed by the blood of Jesus. Every spiritual blockage is removed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I decree that you will conceive. You will carry your pregnancy to full term. You will deliver safely. Your children will be mighty in the land. They will be a blessing to their generation. They will fulfill destiny. They will walk in the fear of the Lord. Father, visit every womb that has been closed. Visit every woman who has been weeping in secret. Visit every man who has been carrying the burden of childlessness. Let there be divine visitation. Let there be supernatural [music] intervention. Open the womb. Heal the body. Correct every abnormality. Remove every obstacle. Let conception happen by your power. Let pregnancy be established by your grace. Let safe delivery be guaranteed by your mercy. I declare over them. They will be fruitful. They will multiply. They will replenish the earth. Their quiver will be full. Their home will be filled with the sound of children. This is their season of fruitfulness in the name of Jesus. Now, as we begin to bring this ministration to a close, I want you to make a final decree over your January. I want you to seal what we have prayed. I want you to establish what we have declared. Open your mouth and say, "Father, I commit this month of January into your hands. I surrender every day to your lordship. I submit every plan to your will. I consecrate every project to your purpose. Let your kingdom come in my life. Let your will be done in my circumstances. I refuse to walk by sight. I choose to walk by faith. I refuse to be moved by what I see. I choose to be anchored in what you have said. Your word is true. Your promises are sure. Your faithfulness endures forever. I will not fear. I will not doubt. I will not worry. I will trust [music] you with all my heart. I will lean not on my own understanding. In all my ways, I will acknowledge you and you will direct my paths. I decree breakthrough [music] in this month. I decree promotion in this month. I decree elevation in this month. I decree acceleration in this month. I decree manifestation in this month. I decree testimonies in this month. Everything that God has promised me, I will see it in this month. Every vision that God has given me, I will experience it in this month. Every prophecy that has been spoken over my life, I will witness its fulfillment in this month. This January is not ordinary. This January is supernatural. This January is my season. This January is my time. I receive it by faith in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, wherever you are, lift up your voice one more time and worship the Lord. Bless his holy name. Magnify him. Adore him. Thank him for answered prayer. Thank him for divine intervention. Thank him for supernatural provision. Thank him for uncommon grace. This is not the end. This is the beginning. This is not the conclusion. This is the introduction. God is about to do something in your life that will amaze you. He's about to show up in ways you never imagined. He's about to open doors you never thought possible. He's about to connect you with people you never expected to meet. He's about to release resources you never thought you could access. This is your season. This is your moment. This is your time. Walk into it with confidence. Walk into it with boldness. Walk into it with faith. You are blessed in the name of Jesus. Amen.
